notes: The session's web search allowance was already used up when this part began (every search was refused), so nothing here comes from a search engine. Everything was found by reading known addresses directly: the campaign websites the candidates filed with the Secretary of State (already in sl_websites; the database was opened read-only), each government's own site, dfl.org, the Legislative Reference Library, and one Wikipedia article. The Secretary of State's sites were never requested. Candidates with no findings are the ones this left out of reach.

Pages were read with the kit's honest User-Agent through states/net.py, each site's robots.txt first; the fetch tool was used for dfl.org/endorsed, stevegander.com, the City of Lakeville's council page and Wikipedia. Hastings Public Schools' site (a thrillshare.com host) asks scripts to stay out and was not read, so Melissa Kinneman has no findings.

Not holding the office today, by the government's own page, and nothing else found: Dennis R. Boucher (Polk County's board page lists Joan Lee for the 4th District), Terry Frost (Otter Tail County's sheriff page names Barry Fitzgibbons as Sheriff), Ronda Szlavich (not on Cambridge's council page), Johnathan Miller (Brainerd's council page lists Gabe Johnson for Ward 4), Robert W. Galler, Jr. (not on the St. Cloud district's board page).

Not reached: the City of Fergus Falls lists its council members by script, so nothing could be read about Erik T. Swanson; Cloquet Public Schools' board page was not found (Don Gentilini); the City of Ramsey's site answered neither address tried; the Minnesota Judicial Branch refuses scripts (part 10's note), so it was not asked about Stephen J. Ferrazzano II.

No Republican unit's endorsement page was found for Gander, Altendorf, Marvin or Witte: three guessed addresses of local units do not exist, and without search there was no way to find the real ones. dfl.org/endorsed lists Chris Ford for Senate District 32 (and, outside this part, Heather Arndt for 20A and Jennifer Compeau for 1B).

Rich Murray: the Legislative Reference Library's record is of a former House member from Albert Lea; the tie to the present mayor rests on the city of residence, the state, and Wikipedia's article, which says the former legislator has been mayor since 2023. The Library's record also carries family, religion and schooling, none of which is recorded here.
Official pages show phone numbers, e-mail and home addresses beside some names (Lyon County, Albert Lea, Mounds View); none was recorded.
Steve Gander, Pam Altendorf and Jeff Witte are sitting legislators with roster records, so only their websites are given.

The site's title reads "Marvin for House" and its one page reads "Robert Marvin for MN State House 38B (coming soon)", copyright 2026. It is the address he filed with the Secretary of State; there is nothing else on it yet.

The site's title reads "Jeff Witte | House of Representatives District 57B"; it reads "Re-Elect Jeff Witte for Minnesota House representing Lakeville in District 57B", is prepared and paid for by Witte for House, and has a page (witteforhouse.com/endorsements/) headed "Endorsements and Distinctions - 2026".
